methods.formation: 3 ordered sets A(first), B(second), C(third); expand full Cartesian product excluding repeated riders
methods.base: For each race compute 1st/2nd/3rd market marginal probabilities from all exact-ordered odds. Optimize EVERY size triple 1..N for this rank-top-k family, using mass minus 90th-percentile implied-ticket-probability times points. Require >=4 actual points.
methods.second: Hold or rank-shift exact vehicle set in 1st, 2nd, 3rd positions; seven sharing masks. Reject unchanged or <4-point second formations.
methods.money: 100 yen per unique 3連単 combination in F1 union F2. Overlaps are not double purchased. Actual full-match payout, zero credit for partial placement matches.
methods.observation: Compare all seven changed-slot patterns and base-only. Train-year highest-ROI policy is evaluated in the subsequent historical year.
methods.data: Existing verified four-market sealed odds/results 2021..2026H1, including independent orientation correction. FINAL odds.

limits: This is a controlled first-stage test of full formation structure; not the paper's original multiple-event payoff theorem.
The top-k rank family is a search restriction; not all 2^(3N) possible rider subsets are searched.
No point count is fixed, but >=4 distinct tickets is required to exclude a disguised two-singleton experiment.
90th-percentile penalty and shift-by-one rank are experimental design parameters, not empirically selected optimal values.
Uses market odds only; cannot establish an independent pricing edge.
Final odds payout proxy, not certified purchase at T-15, and not official settlement.
All evaluation years were historically available in prior research; not genuine future untouched data.
Existing models, purchase rules and websites unchanged.
